convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iVIDyA indicator with simple crossover entry/exit rules, fixed lot sizing, no external dependencies, and standard MT5 order management

derived_values.name: Price vs VIDyA relationship for trend direction

other_exits: Close opposite position on signal reversal before opening new position

custom_logic_notes: iVIDyA Simple EA uses the built-in iVIDyA indicator as a single trend-following filter. Price closing above VIDyA triggers long entry (closing any short first); price closing below VIDyA triggers short entry (closing any long first). SL/TP values are specified in points and need digit-adjustment (multiply by 10) for 5-digit/3-digit brokers where _Point is 0.00001 or 0.001. The new bar guard ensures signals are evaluated only once per completed bar using previous bar values.
python_conversion_notes: VIDyA indicator must be reimplemented in Python: it applies Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO) to dynamically adjust the smoothing constant of an EMA. The CMO absolute value scales the EMA alpha. Use ta-lib or custom implementation for CMO, then apply variable smoothing. Entry logic is straightforward price-vs-indicator crossover on completed bars. Digit adjustment logic for SL/TP must be preserved (if _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001, multiply SL/TP by 10). Signal reversal close-then-open pattern means only one position at a time.
